prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: polished logo concept exploration board, landscape 1536x1024.
Primary request: create one restrained premium corporate identity direction for IHC, a China-to-Russia B2B sourcing and logistics company. Show a distinctive open route symbol with two terminal dots beside a strong clean geometric IHC wordmark. Evolve the supplied brand's sense of two arcs and dots, but redraw a fresh, compact, balanced single route mark. Symbol must work at 24px and look like a route joining two places, never an airplane, globe or generic arrow. Keep negative space clear and icon separated from IHC.
Composition: editorial white board, generous whitespace, dominant horizontal blue logo at upper left, compact standalone blue route symbol at upper right, white reversed logo on a deep blue rectangular field along lower third; precise optical alignment. Flat vector-like artwork, sharp simple geometry, no gradients, no 3D, no mockup objects, no drop shadows. Use only deep corporate blue #15487F, darker #123D72, white and very pale gray. Lettering text verbatim: IHC. No additional text, slogan, claims, dates, annotations, contact details or watermark.
finalArtwork: Deterministic SVG redrawing inspired by generated exploration and original two arcs / dots. All IHC letter outlines are paths without font dependencies.
status: Design system stage 1 proposal; brand approval pending.
